blocks.html:
Where should you start?

If you don't know your first step yet, take them in this order. All three are free, and none of them makes you our client.

  1. 1

    Write the scope

    Using the template in the third article, pin your project down on one page. Do it even if you never work with us.

    Open the scope template →
  2. 2

    Get a rough number

    Answer the estimator's questions and you'll get a brief plus a rough range, based on the features you choose.

    Project estimator →
  3. 3

    Check how safe you are

    The free security self check shows where your site or system is exposed, while there's still time to fix it.

    Start the self check →
